intro: Here, gangs clash in the streets — every hit counts, every ally matters.
Let's put together your first gang?

gangues.party_size_bloqueado: Win more battles to unlock another gang slot.
tutorial_paths: First things first: pick a combat path for your fighter. Each one fights differently.
ATTACKER is pure offense: less health, but hits that really hurt. Great for fast strikes.
DEFENDER takes more punishment and even has a chance to block part of the damage.
MYSTIC is balanced and uses magic: every attack already comes with a guaranteed bonus.
Pick whatever fits your style — you can go different on the next character.
tutorial_attrs: You have 5 points to spend across 4 attributes. Let me walk you through each one.
ATTACK increases the damage you deal with every hit. More points here, harder your punch.
ABILITY decides who acts first each round and also gives your attack an extra bonus.
RESISTANCE sets your max PV and PM. Without at least 1 point here, you go down on the first hit.
DEFENSE reduces the damage you take when attacked.
Each path — Attacker, Defender or Mystic — also has its own bonus. Now it's your turn: build your sheet!

combat_tutorial.iniciativa: This list shows who attacks first this round — the higher a fighter's Skill, the sooner they act.
combat_tutorial.escolher_alvo: More than one enemy? Tap whoever you want to attack to pick them as your target — kill the weakest first or focus the strongest, your call.
combat_tutorial.ver_ficha: Tap whoever's already targeted again (or any ally) to see their full sheet: attributes, PV and PM.
combat_tutorial.trash_talk: That 💬 bubble up top lets you taunt the enemy — free, just for fun.
combat_tutorial.bolinha: That floating orb is where you act now. Tap it: ATTACK resolves instantly for free, POWER costs PM (or PV) but hits harder, and ITEM will show your items once you have any.
combat_tutorial.bolinha_mover: Don't like where it's sitting? Hold and drag it to any corner of the screen — the spot is saved for next time.
combat_tutorial.ko_aviso_tutorial: If an ally goes down in a fight, a red 💀 warning pops up right away — keep an eye out.
combat_tutorial.xp_regra: Battle XP isn't split evenly: finishing off more enemies earns a much bigger slice, damage dealt breaks ties. A fight against weak stuff gives little total XP — don't expect to level up every single time.

multidao.switch_titulo: Turn on Mob Brawl — each round resolves at once, but it's still turn by turn
multidao.usar_item: Use item this round (gives up the attack)

multidao_tutorial.interruptor: Your crew got big (6+ in this fight)! MASS BATTLE unlocked — flip this switch up top to resolve round by round, fast, without picking a target every time.
multidao_tutorial.alvo_automatico: In this mode, each of yours always auto-attacks the weakest enemy — no manual targeting, it's built to clear a big crew fast.
multidao_tutorial.poderes: Tap a fighter's name down here to cycle between a normal attack and their powers — if they have more than one equipped, it rotates between them each tap.
multidao_tutorial.avancar: Then just tap NEXT ROUND as many times as it takes until the fight's over.
multidao_tutorial.item: The 🎒 next to a name marks "use item this round" — that fighter gives up their attack to use an item instead.

fundamentos.conteudo:
LDI is a virtual combat system where pain is real.
Three billion players compete for position in the SDR ranking.
Each fighter chooses a primary elemental that defines their powers.

tabela: Damage and strength of elemental attacks
atributos.extra:
Scale: 0 = common | 1 = practitioner | 2 = experienced | 3 = veteran | 4 = elite | 5 = absolute top
HP = R × 5 | MP = PdF × 5

combate.conteudo:
INITIATIVE: H + 1d6 — highest acts first

FA (Melee): F + H + 1d6
FA (Elemental): PdF + H + 1d6

FD (Normal): A + H + 1d6
FD (Helpless): A + 1d6

DAMAGE: FA − FD (minimum 0)
CRITICAL: die = 6 → doubles F, PdF or A

tabela: Explosive, aggressive. High damage, constant pressure
Balanced. Versatile, no weaknesses, no peaks

vantagens.conteudo:
Advantages cost character points and represent special techniques and powers.
Disadvantages grant extra points but impose real restrictions.

The final balance must be zero: cost of advantages = gain from disadvantages.

xp.conteudo:
Victory in fair battle: +10 XP
Defeat in fair battle: +1 XP

Every 100 XP: 1 character point to spend on attribute or advantage.

story.entry_desc: Take Marelia block by block. From street rat to the Rooftop.
story.sub: Before Alan, nobody held Marelia. A gang on every corner, each one sure it ran the world because it ran one street. One guy — the Patchwork — almost pulled it all together. Almost. Now it's your turn to try.
story.world_hint: Tap a region on the map
story.confronto_final: The one who almost made it
story.precisa_informante: 🔍 Before facing the boss, go back to the Pista and talk to the informant.

fumaca.fala: You quick? I'm smoke, kid. Blink and I'm gone — and you eat it in the dark.

turco.fala: All of Marelia owes me. Now {suaGangue} does too. Round here, whoever can't pay in cash pays in bone.

espeto.fala: The Lowside's been mine since the Shadow hit the ditch. Took my spots? Fine. Come take the rest.

sala.fala: Climbed ten floors just to get dropped on the last one? Respect the effort. Changes nothing.

zefa.fala: I raised half the kids {suaGangue} beat to get up here. Sit down. Your punishment's gonna take a while.

doutor.fala: Do the math, kid. You've got two fighters. I've got the whole Hilltop owing me favors. Now go home.

costura.fala: All of Marelia was mine once. Six blocks in hand, the Rooftop under my feet. But this thing won't stitch — not even I held it. Come up here and I'll show you the hard way.

pista.desc: The asphalt down below. Kids darting the light, snatching chains, selling gum. Nobody important — but everyone starts here. Alan did too.

feira.desc: The stalls, the vendors, the spliced power lines. No shooting here — just debt. The Collector writes it all down, and the Collector collects it all.

baixada.desc: Across the train tracks. The Shadow's crew split three ways when he died. Crimson, Cold and the Leftovers bite each other before they bite you.

vila.desc: The blocks, the ten-floor towers, the unlit stairwell. The crew runs it bottom to top. To reach the owner you climb it all taking hits.

morro.desc: The hillside slum, the concrete stairway that changes shape with every new rooftop. The spots, the firework boys. Nobody comes down the Hill the same.

alto.desc: Past the steel door. The Five nearly became a council — pulled half the Hill into one hand before the Patchwork came, and before you.

laje.desc: The top. On one side, all of Marelia watching. On the other, the Patchwork — the only one who ever held six blocks at once. This is where you find out if seven can be held.

falas.ponto: {territorio}. This spot belongs to {gangue}, pal. {suaGangue} doesn't walk through here for free.

abertura: Sit down, I'll tell you how this works.
Marelia has no king. A gang in every alley, each one thinking it rules the world 'cause it rules one street.
Want to rise? Start on the Track, down below. Take the small gangs' spots, then face the region's heavy — the one holding the flag.
Take the block, the next one opens. Block by block up to the Rooftop.
Up top there's someone nobody knows the real name of. They just call him the Patchwork. He once pulled six blocks under one flag. Nobody ever came closer to owning Marelia.
You'll have to go through him. Good luck, kid — you'll need it.

paragrafos: {gangue} put the Patchwork down on the Rooftop. All of Marelia saw it.
And then you understood what he already knew. Two weeks and the map was split again — blocks pulling one way, spots pulling another. Nobody holds this city. He didn't. You didn't.
Years later a kid with weird hair would do what neither of you could. His name was Alan. But that's another story — and you're in it, right at the start.

modes.historia_desc: Climb the Hill. Take Marelia one step at a time — every turf up to the boss, progress saved.
modes.batalha_desc: A quick 2×2 fight against the opponent you pick. No map progress.
modes.intro: Your gang is born. Now take the streets, one territory at a time.
modes.batalha_bloqueada_desc: One-off battles will arrive in a future update. First, build your story in Marelia.
modes.multiplayer_bloqueada_desc: Online matches against other gangs arrive in a future update.

naming.sub: The fighters matter. But it's the gang's name that echoes — the one enemies spit out, the one that takes Marelia.
naming.poster_pitch: Every street knows a name. Choose the one Marelia will learn to respect.
naming.label: Gang name
naming.placeholder: e.g. End of the Line Crew
naming.preview_vazio: The name all of Marelia will learn to fear.
abertura: First thing: your gang needs a name.
Fighters come and go. The gang's name is what stays — it runs the mouth of the hill, it turns into a legend or into a joke.
Choose well. This is the name the Patchwork spits when you reach the Rooftop.

cena.folego_baixo: The gang's spent. Hit the bar before fighting again.
cena.boss_trancado: Lock the spots down before going up
cena.parada_falha: Botched it — and now there's a fight.
cena.corre_ok: Run done. Nato pays what he owes.
cena.corre_falha: The patrol car saw you. Drop the package and run.
cena.descanso_curou: The gang caught its breath. +{n} wind.
cena.descanso_sem_grana: Not enough cash for a rest.

chegada: This is the Track, kid. The asphalt down below.
Take the little gangs' spots, make your name, and when the whole street knows you Coal comes down to face you.

fala: You with the new gang? You're crazy coming down here alone.
Look, I see everything from this light. Want to know something, trade a word — or some change.

compra.label: Buy the candy and hear what he knows
compra.resultado: He pockets the change. "The junkyard over there, the gate's just a padlock. Good stuff inside."

aperta.label: Lean on the kid to make him talk for free

ignora.label: Ignore him and keep climbing
ignora.resultado: You walk past. The kid spits on the ground. You can see a junkyard just ahead.

ferro.intro: The gate's just a chain and an old padlock. The crew gets on the pick — whoever's got the hands works it, the rest watch the guard.

molecada_1.fala: This alley's ours, pal. The new gang doesn't get through for free.

rinha.fala: There's always somebody here looking to test their luck. Come on, as many times as you can take.

fala: Sit down. Have some mate. You're climbing way too fast for someone nobody knows.
I'll tell you where Coal hides. But first do me a run — take a package across without the patrol car seeing.
After that the Track respects you. And the bar stays open for your crew to rest.

aceita_corre.label: Take Nato's run
aceita_corre.resultado: "Deal. The package is behind the counter. And the Backstab Crew's other spot is up to the right."

so_papo.label: Just want the information
so_papo.resultado: "Stubborn. Then straight up: the other crew's other spot is up there. Take both and Coal shows up."

informante.sub: knows everything that moves in Marelia
fala: Back on the Pista, huh? Good. Everything that happens in Marelia passes through here before it's even a rumor.
There's something going on at the Feira that the people over there won't tell you for free.

perguntar.label: Ask about the Feira
perguntar.resultado: "The Collector only comes out of hiding once he knows his enforcers already took a beating. Go settle things there, and come back if you need more."

corre.intro: Cross the block with the package without stepping into the patrol car's beam. The crew spreads out and covers you.

molecada_2.fala: You again?? Took the alley down there and thought this'd be easy too?

descanso.intro: Some time sitting, off the street. Costs a little change, but the gang comes back whole.
